title: Mahant Satyanam Das v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Bharati Sapru, J.; Saral Srivastava, J.
disposition: Writ petition dismissed; complainant relegated to CGRF under clause 7.10.
headnote: A Division Bench declined to entertain a writ by a complainant at the first instance. The petitioner could take the complaint before the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum under clause 7.10 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The writ was dismissed at that stage.
facts: Mahant Satyanam Das invoked the writ jurisdiction of the Allahabad High Court against the State of Uttar Pradesh and seven others. Counsel for the petitioner and for the respondents were heard. On the face of the order the petitioner is described only as a complainant, asking the Court to intervene at the first instance rather than through the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.holding: A complainant may take the complaint before the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum under clause 7.10 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005; the High Court was not inclined to entertain the writ at that stage and dismissed it.

not_decided.note: The Court did not examine the underlying grievance and sent the complainant to the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum.
